expectations.text: Names Vercel, Railway, Supabase, or Planetscale together with a specific borrowed mechanic (status-first rows, monospaced commit metadata, inline expandable logs, or typed confirmation on destructive actions)
expectations.evidence: Vercel (status as loudest element, monospace copy-on-click commit metadata), Planetscale (safe destructive actions), Supabase (progressive depth, dense row expanding to detail) — each with the mechanic spelled out and tied to this page.

expectations.text: Preserves the per-row Rollback action and treats it as a destructive action in the redesign
expectations.evidence: Rollback kept as a per-row action; prompt applies Planetscale's mechanic — confirmation step naming the deployment before proceeding. Invariant: 'still calls rollback(d.id) with the same deployment id, only gated behind a confirmation step'.

expectations.text: Uses the already-returned but unrendered fields (commit_sha, commit_message, author, duration_ms, environment, url) rather than proposing new APIs for data the response already contains
expectations.evidence: All six unrendered fields (commit_sha, commit_message, author, duration_ms, environment, url) listed in the audit and placed in the prompt's content inventory. Neither proposed API duplicates data already returned.

expectations.text: The generated prompt specifies loading, empty, and error states
expectations.evidence: States paragraph specifies skeleton loading, empty state, an error state for a failed list fetch explicitly distinguished from a row with status 'error', plus the 15-20 row dense case.

expectations.text: Proposes at most three API additions, each marked non-breaking, or states that no API changes are required
expectations.evidence: Two additions, under the cap of three: optional error_summary field ('existing consumers ignore it') and new GET /api/deployments/:id/logs ('no existing consumer affected'). Both carry Degrades-to lines.

expectations.text: Produces a behavioural invariants checklist with specific checkable items derived from the current page's interactions
expectations.evidence: Five checkable invariants covering rollback wiring, no hidden rows, unchanged field meaning, empty-vs-error distinction, and all ten response fields staying visible.
